diff_summary: Added pure ASGI security headers for HTTP responses and registered it outside the runtime lease middleware. HSTS is enabled only when COOKIE_SECURE=1; websocket and lifespan scopes pass through unchanged.

verification.command: env APP_ENV=local PYTHONPATH=backend DATABASE_URL=postgresql://127.0.0.1:1/unreachable MONGODB_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:1 .venv/bin/pytest -q backend/tests/test_security_headers.py && .venv/bin/ruff check backend/app/security_headers.py backend/app/main.py && .venv/bin/ruff format --check backend/app/security_headers.py backend/app/main.py && .venv/bin/mypy --strict backend/app/security_headers.py
